shared_prompt: Create ONE production website illustration matching the approved reference's design language ONLY: very thick rounded navy #0B2545 outlines, opaque white interiors, teal #00ABA9 fills and restrained amber #E8A124 accents. Clean flat vector-like raster icon, no gradients, shadows, texture, text, letters, numbers, labels or watermarks. Actual transparent background. Compact wide composition around 2:1, centered with 8% safe margin, bold simple silhouettes readable in a small homepage thumbnail and a 320px header panel. Do not reproduce the reference's houses/wealth scene; draw only the requested subject. Qualitative decorative art, not measured data. Subject:

subjects.promises: A municipal building silhouette beside a large white checklist with three teal checks and one small amber clock. Civic campaign commitments and follow-up. No politician portraits, party insignia or implied all-promises-met verdict.
subjects.budget: A white municipal budget ledger with simple teal rows, a small amber pie-chart symbol with no exact measured proportions, and two compact stacks of amber coins. Public finances, no currency lettering.
subjects.courts: A balanced navy justice scale with two white/teal pans above a small white case-file folder with an amber tab. Canadian court outcomes; no gavel, police insignia or guilt/innocence labels.
subjects.police: A generic navy-outlined shield, a white document with teal rows, and an amber magnifying glass overlapping one edge. Oversight and public records, no official police crest, weapon, person or implied finding.
subjects.traffic: A compact teal city bus and a small white car beside a navy road bend, with a small amber traffic light. Urban mobility and traffic records. No crash, casualties, road signs, labels or implied numeric traffic result.
subjects.ottawa-elections: A white ballot box with a teal slot, a white paper ballot with a single amber check entering the box, and a small abstract teal municipal ward grid behind it. Municipal voting; grid is deliberately abstract, not a claimed geographic map or election result.
subjects.ontario-elections: Two white ballot papers with teal checkmarks going toward one navy-outlined ballot box; behind them a simple teal branching diagram ending in an amber node. Election comparison and vote-splitting scenarios. No party logos, partisan colours, provincial outline, labels or implied prediction.
subjects.road-safety: A side-profile teal SUV stopped short of a simplified navy pedestrian crossing with one small white/amber walking-person pictogram. Clear space between vehicle and pedestrian. Road safety and vehicle-pedestrian interaction. No collision, injury, motion lines, speed numbers or arrows indicating causality.
subjects.mortgage: A simple navy-outlined white house with teal roof beside a small white calculator with teal keys and one amber key, plus a single amber coin. Home affordability calculator, no text or numeric display and no rising-price arrow.
subjects.hockey: Two simple navy hockey sticks with white/teal blades crossed behind a small black/navy puck and a compact amber trophy cup. Professional women's hockey statistics. No people, team logos, official league branding, letters, digits or scoreboard.
subjects.weather: A white cloud with thick navy outline, a partial amber sun, three teal raindrops and one simple navy/teal thermometer beside it. Long-term climate and weather records, no temperature numbers or trend arrow.
